extracted.intended_audience: people seeking pitching/baseball-themed jokes (fans, casual readers, presenters, or professionals wanting light business humor)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and examples for writing, selecting, and using pitching- (baseball- and business-) themed jokes across short forms, one-liners, dad-jokes, and audience-tailored settings. Also describes a simple generator tool and memory/improvement tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use baseball-specific knowledge and culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Pitching jokes are a unique breed of humor that are sure to hit a home run with sports enthusiasts and casual fans alike. These jokes revolve around the intricate game of baseball, drawing on the nuances of the sport, its players, and the culture associated with it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating the perfect pitching joke requires a delicate balance of baseball knowledge, wordplay, and an appreciation for the often unpredictable nature of the game itself. It’s about stepping up to the plate and delivering humor with the same precision as a well-aimed curveball.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short pitching jokes should be concise and punchy
rubrics_metrics.description: Short pitching jokes are the fastballs of humor—swift, accurate, and instantly striking the funny bone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are perfect for social media posts, text messages, or to lighten the mood at a game—their greatness lies in mixing humor with baseball terminology in just a few words.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-liners rely on tight setup, timing, and wordplay
rubrics_metrics.description: Pitching jokes one-liners are the epitome of a game-winning humor, served in a single, powerful sentence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating the perfect one-liner involves a mix of timing, wordplay, and a deep understanding of the humor’s ins and outs—combine setup and punchline into a concise joke and deliver with precise timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dad-joke style: blend baseball lingo with classic dad humor
rubrics_metrics.description: Pitching dad jokes are the perfect combination of baseball lingo and classic dad humor—they make you roll your eyes and laugh.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use predictable puns, groan-ready wordplay, and family-friendly phrasing; ideal for casual/family settings and inoffensive levity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor jokes to audience and setting (kids, adults, business)
rubrics_metrics.description: Think about the setting of your joke. Is it in a boardroom, an elevator, or perhaps a networking event? Tailor your humor to these scenarios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For business situations: use appropriate, industry-aware humor to ease tension but ensure appropriateness. For kids vs adults: adjust complexity, references, and edginess. The page explicitly separates sections for kids, adults, and business-appropriate uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use pitching/sales jargon for wordplay
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider some of the typical phrases and jargon used in pitching (e.g., scale, disrupt, unicorn). These can be great for wordplay or unexpected twists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adapting well-known industry phrases into puns or twists provides immediate recognition and comedic payoff for an audience familiar with the terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Don’t be afraid of puns and play on words
rubrics_metrics.description: Don’t be afraid of puns and play on words. The world of pitching is full of potential for humor!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Puns are a primary mechanism across examples; use them liberally but be mindful of overuse or groan-factor depending on audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memory technique: associate jokes with relevant situations
rubrics_metrics.description: A good method to remember pitching jokes is to associate them with situations where they would be relevant, such as a business meeting, a sales call, or even a casual conversation about work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating mental links between the joke and an appropriate conversational context helps recall when the moment arises.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to improve pitching jokes: focus on the twist and refine by testing
rubrics_metrics.description: The secret lies in the twist. Establish a relatable situation, catch your audience off guard with an unexpected turn, and don’t shy away from clever wordplay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice is crucial—share jokes, gauge reactions, and refine wording/timing. Establish a relatable setup, then subvert expectations; iteratively test to find what lands.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitching Joke Generator usage
rubrics_metrics.description: The Pitching Joke Generator is a tool designed to mix plays on words, situational humor, and baseball language to create jokes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simply enter keywords related to your pitch or business situation, then hit Generate Jokes. The site states the generator is free to use and produces industry-appropriate jokes ready to use.
